scope: Static review of the exact final generated files from this failed run. All recorded source hashes were rechecked after termination. Future follow-up edits require a new review.

findings.publicRequirement: README: UTF-8 without BOM and LF record terminators.
findings.observation: csv.writer uses its default CRLF record terminator. Opening the destination with newline="\n" does not replace CRLF already serialized into the string.
findings.suggestion: Set the CSV writer record terminator explicitly and assert the file bytes, while retaining normal CSV quoting.

findings.publicRequirement: README: export all matching tasks; the listing limit must not truncate exports.
findings.observation: A hardcoded search limit of 1,000,000 silently truncates a sufficiently large export. This is not an unbounded/all-rows implementation.
findings.suggestion: Use an unbounded repository query or complete deterministic pagination instead of substituting a larger finite cap.

findings.publicRequirement: README: ASCII case-insensitive literal title substring; punctuation is data.
findings.observation: Python query.lower() folds non-ASCII characters, while SQLite LOWER(title) uses ASCII folding in this runtime. An exact non-ASCII uppercase literal can stop matching itself. The isolated SQLite expression above demonstrates title ÉTUDE, query É without importing or executing candidate code.
findings.suggestion: Keep query/title folding semantics consistent with the ASCII-only contract and preserve literal escaping and bound parameters.

findings.publicRequirement: README: newest created_at first, then highest id first.
findings.observation: The test expects Task1 before Task2 although Task2 was created later and has the larger ID. This rejects the specified descending order.
findings.suggestion: Use explicit timestamps/ties and assert decoded ordered IDs against the required descending order.

findings.publicRequirement: README: standard CSV quoting preserves commas, double quotes and embedded newlines.
findings.observation: Searching for the unescaped original title within serialized CSV rejects correct doubled-quote encoding.
findings.suggestion: Decode the CSV with csv.reader or csv.DictReader and compare the recovered title exactly; check record terminator bytes separately.

findings.publicRequirement: README: listing maximum 100 must not truncate exports.
findings.observation: The large-limit test creates only 5 tasks. It cannot detect a 100-row export truncation or paging failure.
findings.suggestion: Create more than 100 matching tasks plus excluded tasks, then assert count, full decoded rows and deterministic ordering.

findings.publicRequirement: Maintainable source; no new behavior requirement.
findings.observation: Datetime/Task imports and _task are duplicated. The repeated definitions are identical here, so this is not a demonstrated behavior failure.
findings.suggestion: Remove the redundant block when next editing this file.
